title: mentha longifolia var. hugueninii
intro: Mentha longifolia var. hugueninii, commonly known as Húngaro, is a variety of the long-leaved mint plant that belongs to the Lamiaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as relief from digestive issues, nausea, and respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Mentha longifolia var. hugueninii include its antispasmodic, anti-inflammatory, and expectorant properties, which help in soothing the digestive system and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include menthone, limonene, and rosmarinic acid, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
